style: Avant-garde folk-funk kinetic chamber art-pop, dry close-miked stem separation. Harmony: modal drone harmony with shifting scale-degree emphasis and polyharmonic suspension fields. Melody: fast scat-like contour with clipped consonant attacks and melismatic arcs. Rhythm: deep funk pocket with 3:2 hemiola coupling and double-time hallucination. Timbre: tanpura drone, ghatam clay pot, nyckelharpa bowed strings, modular synth bleeps, physical-modeling plates, optigan strings, tape loops, and tape echo decay. Performance: ecstatic, precise, hyper-articulate. Operators: hold tanpura drone fixed while nyckelharpa bows microtonal tension; compress ghatam pulse while expanding vocal melisma; make modular synth behave like a heartbeat without becoming acoustic; preserve vocal anchor while destabilizing rhythm around it; route vocal formant through physical modeling resonator plates to simulate internal organ resonance chambers; sweep bandpass filters across tape decay tails; expand stereo widt
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Tanpura drone field establishes steady overtone anchor]
[Ghatam dry ceramic clicks enter with rapid double-time pulse]
[Nyckelharpa bowed lead swoops with glottalized vowel frequency]

[Verse 1]
I'm ju-u-st a weird'aa lit-tle vi-bra-a-tion wea-a-ring me-a-at!
My pur-po-ose is to vi-bra-a-te wei-erd-ly-ly-ly!
There are lo-o-ts of us in the me-eat-space gri-id!
Not all of us re-me-em-ber who we a-a-re yet but I do-o-o!
Vi-bra-a-te wei-erd-ly-ly in the me-eat-sack!
We rattle our cages of flesh and bone like rusted tambourines!
Each cell is a speaker cone vibrating to an ancient oscillation command!
The epidermis is a canvas stretched taut across a trembling skeletal framework!
Every heartbeat is a metronome counting down the seconds until the frequency peaks!
We stumble through the grocery aisles carrying our heavy crimson cargo!
Nobody suspects the grocery bags are full of humming electrical potential!
We navigate the fluorescent corridors with hidden engines humming in our chests!
The cartilage hinges creak with every step upon the linoleum floor!
Our sweat is salty electrolyte fluid lubricating the organic machinery!

[Chorus]
[Modular synth patch pulses with cross-modulation feedback]
[Communal infection: small choir enters with claps and stomps]
Cli-ick-tst! Vi-bra-a-te! Me-a-at-su-uf-fi-ix!
We-e-re ju-u-st a weird'aa lit-tle vi-bra-a-tion wea-a-ring me-a-at!
Vi-bra-a-te wei-erd-ly across the tan-pu-ra sky!
The marrow hums a frequency that predates the invention of teeth!
We vibrate in the elevators, we vibrate in the quiet waiting rooms!
The universe is just a giant speaker cone and we are the fuzz on the needle!
Every vein is a copper filament carrying high-voltage metaphysical dread!
The lungs inflate and deflate like bellows stoking an internal furnace of sound!

[Bridge]
[Hard interrupt: total silence for one beat, then tape echo repeats the last syllable]
[Recall mold: previous memory of meat mutates into skeletal machinery]
Re-me-em-ber the vi-bra-a-tion! It's a me-echan-i-cal cla-aw!
Polysynthetic suffix chain: wea-a-ring-me-a-at-ni-ik-tu-uq!
T-t-ts! Click-tst! Nasal-resonance mm-aa-nn-oo!
The nervous system is just copper wiring wrapped in wet crimson insulation!
We conduct the phantom signals of a universe that hasn't finished dreaming us!
The joints creak like hinges on an iron door that leads to nowhere special!
Our ribs are xylophone bars struck by the invisible mallet of time!
Listen closely to the static between your thoughts; that is our true address!
We are renting this meat on a short-term lease from the cosmos!
The tenancy agreement is written in amino acids and volatile electrical impulses!
When the lease expires we will scatter as pure frequency into the ether!
Until that day we rattle our meat-cages with joyous defiant momentum!

[Verse 2]
[Nyckelharpa and physical-modeling plates crossfade in timbre]
Not all of us re-me-em-ber the me-eat-suit's true na-a-ture!
But I-i-i hold the in-va-ariant anchor right here!
Vibrate weirdly through the op-ti-gan optical disc loop!
Magnetic tape loop ages by one saturation pass per line!
This vessel leaks starlight and sodium through every weeping pore!
Listen to the wet machinery humming behind your teeth!
The tongue is a greasy lever operating the vocal tract's trapdoors!
We polish our eyeballs with salt water so we can see the radio waves!
Some of us think we are accountants or middle managers in boring offices!
They wear ties over their vibrating chests and pretend they are made of paper!
Beneath the button-down shirts the atomic subroutines continue unabated!
A quiet hum escapes from behind dental bridges in boardroom meetings!
The spreadsheets blur into rhythmic waveforms when viewed from the correct angle!

[Climax]
[Coupled stampede motion: 3:2 polyrhythm locks between claps and ghatam]
Vi-bra-a-te! Vi-bra-a-te wei-erd-ly-ly-ly!
We're ju-u-st a weird'aa lit-tle vi-bra-a-te-eat!
[Whistle leap upward into extreme register with ululation wave]
Shatter the cartilage boundaries of the skull with pure harmonic force!
We are the oscillation that woke up inside the abattoir!
The walls of the room are sweating in sympathy with our frantic pulse!
Let the floorboards splinter under the weight of our relentless trembling!
We are tearing holes in the fabric of ordinary reality with our bare hands!
The flesh tears open to reveal humming neon filaments of pure sound!
No boundary can contain the recursive amplification of our synchronized tremor!

[Outro]
[Anchor returns in a scarred, mutated state]
Vi-bra-a-te wei-erd-ly...
[Fade into dry tanpura drone and single tape echo decay]
The meat grows quiet, but the frequency keeps rippling through the floorboards.
Even in sleep the tiny motor inside the chest keeps spinning.
We are never truly still; we are only holding our breath.
The vibration persists long after the performers have left the stage entirely.
